card.name: Just before a number in general text
card.fires_on: The spot right before a figure begins in web text on statistics, money or measurements. It is usually an opening parenthesis, a dollar sign, a space, or 'over' or 'more than' just before the digits.

modes.label: Comparison word
modes.description: A word like over or more than that leads into a number.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to produce the digits of a large number or amount.
